passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was a king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David prayed to God.
David praised God in his psalms.

passages.text: I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to the LORD.
David calls to the LORD for help.
David asks the LORD to come quickly to him.
David asks the LORD to hear his voice.
David calls to the LORD.
passages.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִיךָ ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקָרְאִי־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: May my prayer be set before You like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David prays to God.
David wants his prayer to come before God.
David wants his prayer to be like incense.
David lifts his hands to God.
David wants his lifted hands to be like the evening offering.
passages.original: תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י מִנְחַת־ עָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks the LORD to protect his words.
David says, "LORD, set a guard over my mouth."
David asks the LORD to watch over the door of his lips.
David wants the LORD to keep him from speaking wrongly.
passages.original: שִׁיתָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה שָׁמְרָ֣ה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־ דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃

passages.text: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
passages.sermon:
God, do not let my heart desire anything evil.
Do not let me join in wicked actions.
Do not let me act with people who do wrong.
Do not let me enjoy the pleasures they offer.
passages.original: אַל־ תַּט־ לִבִּ֨י לְדָבָ֪ר׀ רָ֡ע לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת׀ בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־ אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי־ אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־ אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
passages.sermon:
A righteous man may correct me.
His correction is an act of loving devotion.
His rebuke is like oil for my head.
I will not refuse his correction.
I always pray against the deeds of the wicked.
passages.original: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־ צַדִּ֨יק׀ חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־ יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ ע֥וֹד וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
passages.sermon: The rulers fall from the cliffs.\r\nThe people hear my words.\r\nMy words are pleasant.
passages.original: נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־ סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃

passages.text: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
passages.sermon:
A person plows the earth.
A person breaks up the soil.
This action scatters the soil.
In the same way, our bones have been scattered.
Our bones lie at the mouth of Sheol.
Sheol is the place of the dead.
passages.original: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃

passages.text: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
passages.sermon:
David was in a cave.
\r\nDavid prayed to God.
\r\nDavid spoke to the Lord.
\r\nDavid said, “My eyes look to You, O Lord God.”
\r\nDavid trusted in God for safety.
\r\nDavid said, “I take refuge in You.”
\r\nDavid asked God, “Do not leave my soul without help.”
passages.original: כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ׀ יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י עֵינָ֑י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־ תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
passages.sermon:
David is in a cave.
David prays to God.
David asks God to protect him.
David says, "Keep me safe from traps."
David says, "My enemies set these traps for me."
David says, "Keep me safe from the snares of evildoers."
David says, "Evildoers try to catch me with their lures."
passages.original: שָׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this prayer when he was in a cave.
David asked God for help.
David spoke about wicked people.
Wicked people set traps for others.
David wanted the wicked to fall into their own traps.
David wanted to pass by safely.
David asked God to let him escape while the wicked are caught.
passages.original: יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד־ אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃
